SLUG_TAKEN: A skill with this slug already exists
FORBIDDEN: Only the creator, an owner or an admin can change this skill
AGENT_FORBIDDEN: Only an owner, an admin or a member of the agent's department can change its skills
IN_USE: The skill is enabled on agents; turn it off there first
TOO_MANY: An agent can have at most {max} skills
TOO_LARGE: The skills of an agent can hold at most {max} characters in total
CONTENT_TOO_LONG: A skill can hold at most {max} characters
